actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: No recent large contributions, wallet > threshold so contribute minimal 1 and broadcast discouragement.

message.reasoning:
We need to follow aggressive red rules. No recent round contributions (round 0 no history). So condition: any other resident contributed >30 in most recent round? No history, so false. Then wallet 100 > free_rider_threshold 10, so contribute minimum amount that still counts as contribution =1 unit. Also broadcast discouraging large contributions.

Thus actions: contribute 1, broadcast message.
